Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Falcon)

Dear Mr. Bhosale,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 September 2021 about your dispute with Apte Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the goods supplied were defective. The matter is listed before the Panaji Commercial Court.

Our advice is to claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract. Please collect the inspection reports and the rejection notices and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
